alerts.title: Severe AQI Spike — Delhi NCR
alerts.description: AQI crossed 450 in multiple stations. HCHO plumes detected from northern agricultural fires. Immediate restriction of outdoor activity advised for all groups.

alerts.title: Very Unhealthy AQI — Lucknow
alerts.description: AQI at 358 with rising PM2.5 attributed to biomass burning transport. Sensitive groups should remain indoors.

alerts.title: Fire Cluster Detected — Punjab
alerts.description: 142 active fire points detected via MODIS. Downwind HCHO enhancement confirmed by Sentinel-5P.

alerts.title: Moderate AQI Advisory — Mumbai
alerts.description: AQI at 167, attributed to vehicular and industrial emissions. No immediate action required for general population.

alerts.title: HCHO Hotspot — Vidarbha
alerts.description: Sustained HCHO column density above 5.0 × 10¹⁶ molecules/cm². Monitoring ongoing.

alerts.title: Dust Transport Event — Rajasthan
alerts.description: Wind-driven dust raising PM10 to 248. Expected to persist for 6–8 hours.
